hypothesis: Distributing each token's eight bitmap and scale loads across the four cooperating lanes, then computing prefix counts with a two-step warp scan, will shorten metadata staging on the producer path.

baseline.description: Reuse E001 as the direct-kernel baseline; do not recollect baseline profiles or timings.

validation.decode_cases: H64/H128 x B8/B16 x K512/K317, including existing partial-top-k, poisoned-padding, and CUDA-graph cases
validation.timing: Two passes; reuse the existing microbench with 10 warmups, 100 replays, and 30 rounds.
validation.decision_gate: All validity cases pass, memcheck is clean, no new spills, at least 5% geometric-mean Direct improvement, and no shape regresses over 2%.
validation.memcheck: 8 passed, 0 errors; 4 cases deselected by the focused selector
validation.pass1_target: 2% Direct-vs-Native p95 target missed on all eight cases
validation.pass2_target: 2% Direct-vs-Native p95 target missed on all eight cases; p95 regressions 32.45-102.27%
validation.profile_shape_regression: H64/B16 +0.65%; no profiled shape exceeded +2% kernel time

decision.performance: rejected: pass 1/2 Direct median geomeans are 2.26%/1.66% slower than E001; both passes regress H64 by more than 2%; all eight Direct-vs-Native p95 cases miss. Direct-only NCU kernel time improves 2.35% geomean, below the 5% threshold.
decision.result: reject as a performance candidate; E002 source was removed from the active tree when E003 began; retain E002 artifacts and do not update production pins
